## Scope

- Products list and editor with Variants, prices, status, barcode; Categories, Brands, Suppliers, Colour list screens; Stock screen with adjustments and low-stock list.
- Barcode/SKU scan or search on the Products list opens the Product (exact first).

## Acceptance

- [ ] Staff and Owner see the correct fields and actions.
- [ ] A Product can be created with Variants and published (once photos exist).
